newsitem.title: MOROCCO: French-Italian SGS-Thomson extends site in Morocco.
newsitem.headline: French-Italian SGS-Thomson extends site in Morocco.

text.p: French-Italian SGS-Thomson inaugurated on Tuesday a $100 million extension of one of its two electronics sites in Casablanca, its manager said.
"Ain Sebaa factory is one of the five assembly and test plants of SGS-Thomson throughout the world," said Pasquale Pistorio, general manager of the group.
The site covers presently 26,000 square metres from an initial 18,000 square metres and has a capacity to assemble one billion electronic components annually.
SGS-Thomson said it plans to invest $300 million in its second Casablanca plant in two years, if this extension proves successful.
It was established in Morocco in 1952 and employs 2,600 people.
